resources.string: Wearable workouts
Completed exercise sessions exported to Health Connect by Mi Fitness or other apps. Sync imports sessions starting in the last seven days.

Imported workouts are separate from your counted logs. Only confirmed sessions add duration and available active calories to your activity log. No XP, quests or weekly guided-workout credit is awarded. Elapsed duration can include pauses.

%1$s · prepared at %2$s

Start the same activity on your band within 30 minutes. Finish on the band, let Mi Fitness sync to Health Connect, then tap Sync here and confirm the matching session below. This screen does not control the band or show live sensor readings.
Record this workout

Save the wearable duration and available active calories to your activity log. Confirm that you have not logged this workout manually. Overlapping counted guided or wearable workouts are blocked. Missing calories are excluded from calorie totals and labelled unavailable. This explicitly saves the session metadata to your Firebase account.
